title: Install supported skills into an available destination
actor: A project user obtaining RigorLoop skills for a supported target
goal: Install complete verified skills into the selected target location without changing unrelated project content.
context: The project has selected a supported skill target and its candidate destination units are absent.
trigger: The user requests installation of a compatible version.
preconditions: The target and requested version/source are identified and the user has applicable installation authority.

interaction.action: Selects the supported target and requests installation from the trusted official source.
Identifies the verified candidate and reports complete destination preflight or the blocking condition.
Reports the actual installed units and verified result, or known partial effects and untouched scope.

expected_outcome: The selected verified units are installed completely, unrelated skills and project state remain unchanged, and the user can distinguish completion from partial failure.

alternatives.condition: Unrelated skills or project-root state files already exist.
alternatives.outcome: They are preserved and their presence or contents do not determine installation admission.

alternatives.condition: The user explicitly selects a local archive instead of network acquisition.
alternatives.outcome: The same bundled trusted metadata, compatible version, archive integrity, and extraction checks apply; the local file supplies no alternative trust root.

failures.condition: The target or option is unsupported, or a pinned version would restore a retired target.
failures.outcome: The request rejects before acquisition or writes with the supported form identified.

failures.condition: Trusted metadata, archive integrity, extraction containment, or destination safety cannot be established.
failures.outcome: Installation stops at the identified boundary without claiming installed success.

failures.condition: A unit appears or changes after preflight or installation only partly completes.
failures.outcome: The system stops, preserves known effects, and reports completed, partial, and untouched units without overwriting new work.
